Beat Maker Go is the ultimate drum pad machine app. With Beat Maker Go, you can perform beats easily and create amazing music tracks with 200+ sound packs from our library. Share your music with friends and other people on social media or anywhere you like.

This app is for beginners and PRO beat makers. If you are just getting started with music, our easy lessons will help you learn how to get into beat making the right way. Get a new cool hobby with Beat Maker Go.

But it’s not just for beginners. Experienced beat makers will love our "Advanced mode". Practice skills and grow with 2,000+ lessons. Listen and repeat the beats, create your own loops, record and share them.

Use loops, blend them, and record your performance in a fun way. Use the pads to create top-notch mixtapes or music sets. Play while you are on the move.

The presets library offers the most recent sound packs in various genres:
Hip-Hop
Trap
House
EDM
Dubstep
Techno
Rock
Synthwave

This app is ideal if you would like to create music like an established producer. High-quality samples are made by professional sound producers and dedicated musicians. This partnership helps us keep the app up-to-date and provides you with even better stuff on a regular basis!

ACADEMY:
Learn how to make beats like a pro with the academy. Lessons in 70+ packs. Learn how to make beats like a pro. Upgrade your skills.


FEATURES:
- High-quality samples (uncompressed 16-bit, 44.1 KHz).
- 32 pads in two banks.
- Predefined beat loops in every sound preset.
- Overdub feature to add sounds to recorded loops.
- Music recording and sharing.
- Voice recording.

Follow our interactive tutorial and go through every step of beat making right now!
